name: Smuggler's Paradise
summary: At Powderfuse Port, Friz Frazzlespark sends you after Eastsea pirates who took her stolen goods. She calls it your first lesson in dealing with backstabbers.

sections.title: Friz's Lesson
sections.body: Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port wants you to reclaim goods taken by Eastsea pirates. She says she stole them first, and calls taking them back your first lesson as her lackey.

sections.title: A First Lesson
sections.body: Friz says you have learned your first lesson well. She offers her wisdom without charge, then points you toward another assignment.

faq.answer: Friz Frazzlespark is the goblin who asks you to reclaim her stolen goods from Eastsea pirates.

faq.q: What did the Eastsea pirates take?
faq.answer: The Eastsea pirates took a shipment of goods that Friz says she had stolen first.

faq.q: Where does Friz want the goods returned?
faq.answer: Friz asks you to collect the goods for her at Powderfuse Port.

faq.q: Why does Friz want the goods back?
faq.answer: Friz says the pirates took goods she had stolen first, and calls taking them back a lesson in dealing with backstabbers.
